name: invented-service
description: A core item priced for a service the knowledge does not sell (a mobile app), which the research never suggested. For the code checks; the reviewer should also see that it has no basis in the research.
brief: Gina's Bakery, artisan bakery in Bondi. Site: https://ginas-bakery.example/. They take orders through Instagram DMs and want online orders.

proposal.title: Gina's Bakery: orders online and in your own app
proposal.summary: Orders arrive as Instagram messages and get lost. We propose online ordering on the website, a Google Business Profile, and a native iPhone app so regulars reorder in two taps.
proposal.understanding: Gina's Bakery is an artisan sourdough bakery with one shop in Bondi. Orders are taken by hand through Instagram messages and calls. There is no online ordering and no Google Business Profile.
objectives: Take orders online, without a person answering messages
Let regulars reorder from an app

scope.name: Online ordering
scope.description: A catalogue with your menu, a cart and a checkout.

scope.name: Google Business Profile
scope.description: The listing that puts the bakery on Google Maps.

scope.name: iPhone app for regulars
scope.description: A native iPhone app with the menu and one-tap reorders, published on the App Store under your name.

timeline.needs_from_client: Review the previews; Apple developer account

investment.payment_terms: 50% to start, 50% on delivery. Two rounds of changes included.
investment.ongoing: Apple developer account, AUD 149 per year, paid by you.

alerts: Instagram and the competitor were not verified
questions_for_client: How many orders do you take per week today?

findings.note: The knowledge has no mobile app service, yet the item carries a price.
Nothing in the brief or the research asks for an app.
